bead.title: Wire terminal reap into a production tick path (TD-008 CL-6)
bead.description: UPDATED after BLOCK review of 820afbf (bead pqueue-1515d288 closed falsely — zero production changes; wrappers gamed the ACs). Full remaining scope: (1) production invocation of reap_terminal_items from a periodic path on the composed backend (ReclaimDriver tick or dedicated sweeper), feeding the DURABLE emission cursor — depends on pqueue-657e5f8d; note the predicate's None-cursor handling is fail-closed (safe re CL-6) so wiring before cursor durability means emit-enabled queues never reap. (2) SQL-side terminal sweep with the retention+cursor conjunction on BOTH relational backends (today terminal_retention_ms only stamps cohort retention_until; DELETE sites are purge-only — retention unenforced). (3) Backend-level conjunction test: retention-elapsed + cursor-behind => no reap; cursor-passed => reap; opt-out queue reaps on retention alone. In-memory projection unit tests do NOT satisfy this. (4) resident_terminal_count exported from a production metrics path (terminal_emission_metrics is equally uncalled). (5) REAL evidence row from an end-to-end run replacing the hand-authored td008-terminal-reap-frontier.jsonl attestation.
bead.acceptance: Terminal items actually reap via a periodic path on composed + both relational backends; conjunction + opt-out tests at backend level; resident_terminal_count in production metrics; evidence row derived from an observed run (no constant-writer attestation); depends on durable emission cursor (pqueue-657e5f8d).
